data.name: Whale Watch
data.headline: Great for all ages • 3 - 3.5 Hours
data.description:
Experience the Ultimate Whale Watching Adventure with Wild Pacific Whale Watch in San Diego!

Get ready for an unforgettable journey aboard our stunning 85-foot vessel on Wild Pacific’s 3-Hour Whale Watch Tour—San Diego’s premier marine adventure! Cruise the sparkling waters of the Pacific in comfort and style as we set course from the harbor and into the heart of whale country.

Our tour is more than just whale watching—it's a deep dive into the vibrant world of marina life. From playful dolphins and curious sea lions to soaring seabirds and colorful fish, you’ll witness the coastal ecosystem in all its glory. And of course, the stars of the show: majestic whales, often just feet from the boat! Whether it’s the awe-inspiring gray whales on their epic migration, the breathtaking blue whales in summer, or even a pod of orcas making a rare appearance, every trip holds the promise of magic.

Perfect for families, nature lovers, and photographers alike, this tour combines educational insight, marine conservation awareness, and thrilling encounters with some of the ocean’s most iconic creatures. With panoramic viewing decks and knowledgeable crew, Wild Pacific Whale Watch offers the most exciting and immersive whale watching experience in San Diego.

Don’t just see the ocean—experience it with Wild Pacific! Book your adventure today and let the wild come to life before your eyes.

data.booking_notes:
#Thank you for booking your whale watching experience with Wild Pacific Whale Watch! 

**We’re thrilled to have you aboard and can't wait to share the magic of the Pacific with you.**

#Important Info Before You Arrive
- Bring layers—weather can shift on the water & it is typically 15 degrees cooler out on the water 
- Non-slip shoes recommended 
- Restrooms and snacks available (for sale) onboard 
- Please allow plenty of time for parking (2 paid lots nearby) ESPECIALLY during the summer weekends and during holidays Additional Paid Parking Can Be Found Here: 5003 N. Harbor Drive San Diego, CA 92106
- Please complete waivers for everyone in your party before arriving in order to speed up the check-in process
- Motion Sickness-although our vessel is equipped with advanced technology with onboard stabilizers: no vessel is immune to all movement on the water and no one can give a “no seasickness guarantee.” If you are particularly susceptible to motion sickness, we recommend taking motion sickness pills 30 minutes prior to departure. We also sell meclazine onboard and have Seasickness relief bands available for rent.
- For answers to additional questions, check out our FAQ’s on our website or give us a call!
__________________________
##Cancellation Policy
Cancellations made at least 24 hours in advance are eligible for a full refund. Cancellations within 24 hours or no-shows are non-refundable. If we cancel due to weather or sea conditions, you will receive a full refund or the option to reschedule.
If you wish to change or cancel your reservation and are within our cancellation period, you can select the option to rebook or cancel towards the top of this email (your confirmation email).
_________________________
Thank you again for choosing Wild Pacific Whale Watch. We can’t wait to show you the wild side of San Diego from the best seat on the water.
Let’s Explore the Wild Together  
- **The Wild Pacific Team**
